description.value: Henry's B-Y Market is a convenience store located on Hays Cove Avenue in the Prince Rupert area of BC's North Coast. The area is a key stop on the BC Ferries route connecting the mainland to Haida Gwaii and Alaska, making resupply options here relevant to long-distance touring cyclists. Operating status is currently unconfirmed.
